title: Countable partition of a null-measurable D ⊆ Ω into disjoint null-measurable pieces inside open sets on which a locally Lipschitz map is Lipschitz
statement: Let n, Q ∈ ℕ, Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ open, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q locally Lipschitz on Ω, and D ⊆ Ω Lⁿ-null-measurable. Then there are sets V_m, B_m ⊆ ℝⁿ and constants K_m ∈ ℝ≥0 (m ∈ ℕ) such that every V_m is open, V_m ⊆ Ω, u is K_m-Lipschitz on V_m, B_m ⊆ D ∩ V_m, the B_m are pairwise disjoint, every B_m is Lⁿ-null-measurable, and D ⊆ ⋃_m B_m.
lean_statement: ∀ (n Q : ℕ) (Ω D : Set (Eucl n)) (u : Eucl n → Eucl Q), IsOpen Ω → LocallyLipschitzOn Ω u → D ⊆ Ω → NullMeasurableSet D (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) → ∃ (V B : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)) (K : ℕ → ℝ≥0), (∀ m, IsOpen (V m)) ∧ (∀ m, V m ⊆ Ω) ∧ (∀ m, LipschitzOnWith (K m) u (V m)) ∧ (∀ m, B m ⊆ D ∩ V m) ∧ Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint B) ∧ (∀ m, NullMeasurableSet (B m) (volume : Measure (Eucl n))) ∧ D ⊆ ⋃ m, B m
